subject.title: Add gated Claw discovery and API projection

question: Should ClawHub adopt `claw` as an unstable, deployment-gated family within the existing public `/api/v1/packages` contract and accept this four-PR stack order?
rationale: Tests can validate the implementation, but they cannot decide whether Claw packages belong in the permanent registry/API model or whether maintainers accept the proposed experimental compatibility commitment and coordinated rollout.

options.title: Sponsor the gated stack
options.body: Approve the RFC direction and existing-package-API approach, then review and land the four slices in dependency order with the flag disabled until rollout proof is complete.

options.title: Narrow or redesign the contract
options.body: Keep the draft open while maintainers choose a different API boundary, schema shape, or smaller experimental slice before implementation proceeds.

options.title: Decline Claw registry support
options.body: Close the stack if complete-agent package distribution should not become a ClawHub registry capability.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the gated stack
recommendation.body: Approve the RFC direction and existing-package-API approach, then review and land the four slices in dependency order with the flag disabled until rollout proof is complete.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice changes ClawHub's public registry and API product boundary rather than requiring only a mechanical code repair.
